Select IC50 activities against human Pim-1 kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, and compound_records. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and target organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
